name: Enix Gray
source:
Zodiac: Pisces

Enix is MC's dependable and loyal childhood best friend... and secret, lifelong crush.

Likes: video games, baseball, toy collecting, drawing and his blue goldfish named "Samus"
Dislikes: Being compared to his elder brothers, self-pity, family reunions and drunks. 

Fun Fact: He's a Dungeons and Dragons fanatic.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/love-spell-written-in-the-stars]official website[/url]]
